title: Christmas ads 2026: did Tesco or Sainsbury’s win over UK shoppers?
summary: We showed the 2026 Tesco and Sainsbury’s Christmas ads to 60 UK adults in AI-moderated video interviews.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


-


We showed the 2026 Tesco and Sainsbury’s Christmas ads to 60 UK adults. Tesco’s won the vote, 33 to 27.


-


Sainsbury’s made more people likelier to shop there: 26 raised their score, against 18 for Tesco.


-


People who smiled while watching or talking about the Sainsbury’s ad raised their score by 1.2 points on average. Those who didn’t smile dropped 0.2. 7 of the 26 who raised their Sainsbury’s score mentioned the food at the end.
